title: Pullback preserves native adic constructibility
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$ and $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. For any scheme $X$, let $B_X$ be the locally finite continuous $\Omega$-valued coefficient sheaf of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework], applied on $X_{\mathrm{proet}}$ itself rather than on a geometric fibre, and let $\mathcal A(X)=\operatorname{Mod}(B_X)$. Use the same lisse and constructible conditions as that framework: lisse means pro-etale locally $B^{\oplus r}$ with $r$ finite and allowed to depend on the covering member; constructible means locally on the scheme a finite constructible locally closed partition with lisse restrictions. For a scheme morphism $f:Y\to X$, let $f^*M=B_Y\otimes_{f^{-1}B_X}f^{-1}M$, with the coefficient map induced by precomposition of functions. For every scheme morphism $f:Y\to X$ and every constructible $M\in\mathcal A(X)$, the module sheaf $f^*M$ is constructible on $Y$.
